info.name: MedicationTestOrdersValidation
info.description:
Postman collection for MedicationTestOrdersValidation — medication, diagnostic-test, and allergy-drug validation.

**Setup**
1. Import this collection.
2. Start the service: `python main.py` in MedicationTestOrdersValidation (port 8006).
3. Set baseUrl if needed (default http://localhost:8006).

request.description: Validate medications against full patient and encounter data.
Validate diagnostic test orders against patient data.
Check proposed drugs against documented allergies. Patient details are optional.
Same allergy-drug check with no patient object.
